title: Study on Safety and Efficacy of an Oral Contraceptive in Treating Acne Papulopustulosa
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine safety and efficacy of an oral contraceptive in treating acne papulopustulosa.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with mild to moderate facial papulopustular acne

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindication against use of hormonal contraceptives
